mastery_commentary.Tia: I asked for bard certification; the supplier quoted a winter waiting list. The potion can keep its mythic strength until then.

2-20.description: One of the potions of the Underworld.
2-20.bottle_note: Brings you to the glittering golden sunset, the boundary between reality and illusion. The ethereal horizon where the soul finds peace.
2-20.original_bottle_note: Brings you to the glittering golden sunset, the boundary between reality and illusion. The ethereal horizon where the soul finds peace.
2-20.expanded_lore: A dusk pendant crystallized in the Underworld’s last-lit passage gives Elixir of Twilight its amber border between day and night. Its label calls it an Underworld brew, while the miners remember it as the first warm light they saw on the way back up.
2-20.supplier_note: The road office logged this Pendant of dusk parcel against Elixir of Twilight. Keep it sealed until the workbench is clear and the receipt is signed. The paired potion’s original label reads: "One of the potions of the Underworld."

mastery_commentary.Pio: The dusk pendant marks the Underworld's last light; Elixir of Twilight glows warmly, though the night porter still prefers a pouch.
mastery_commentary.Tia: I trust the evening-star crystal, not its directions. The porter stopped asking who was at the door once I covered the glow.

2-21.description: This reagent is used in some experiments.
2-21.bottle_note: It is packaged beautifully. There seems to be screaming coming from inside the bottle...
2-21.original_bottle_note: It is packaged beautifully. There seems to be screaming coming from inside the bottle...
2-21.expanded_lore: A yellow-glass cursed topaz ring left behind by an abandoned experiment lends Sunset Cursed Reagents their golden mark. The source note merely calls it a reagent; the color is what made the lab assistants nickname the unfinished study “the sunset file.”
2-21.supplier_note: The road office logged this Cursed Topaz ring parcel against Cursed Sunset Reagent. Keep it sealed until the workbench is clear and the receipt is signed. The paired potion’s original label reads: "This reagent is used in some experiments."

mastery_commentary.Pio: A yellow-glass topaz ring outlived its inventor's experiment; Sunset Cursed Reagents stays lab stock, not an engagement offer.
mastery_commentary.Tia: The sunset file's ring is tagged and measured. I removed the jewelry box from the counter after Pio nearly staged a proposal.

2-22.description: A potion adventurers use in Underworld.
2-22.bottle_note: It is much cheaper when purchased in the Underworld. When humans drink it however...
2-22.original_bottle_note: It is much cheaper when purchased in the Underworld. When humans drink it however...
2-22.expanded_lore: Fine powder from a yellow demon horn gives Demon’s Minor SP Potion a compact restorative edge for Underworld adventurers. The potion makes no claim to greatness; its horn is already dramatic enough for the whole bottle.
2-22.supplier_note: The road office logged this Demon's yellow horn parcel against Demon's Minor SP Potion. Keep it sealed until the workbench is clear and the receipt is signed. The paired potion’s original label reads: "A potion adventurers use in Underworld."

mastery_commentary.Pio: Ember-tinted yellow horn dust gives the minor SP potion a compact lift; licensed trimming keeps the shop from tracking a powder trail.
mastery_commentary.Tia: The sealed horn dust is easy to measure and even easier to spill. I clean the scoop before Pio can call the yellow trail a map.

2-23.description: A serum which can cause a wide range of plagues.
2-23.bottle_note: Who created it and for what purpose is unknown. Has no effect on demons.
2-23.original_bottle_note: Who created it and for what purpose is unknown. Has no effect on demons.
2-23.expanded_lore: Neutralized yellow plague spores give Yellow Plague Serum its broad experimental profile, but the guild keeps the batch sealed and away from healing stock. The original note names the possible harm plainly; the golden lace beneath the fungus explains its appearance, not its use.
2-23.supplier_note: The road office logged this Yellow plague of spore parcel against Yellow Plague Serum. Keep it sealed until the workbench is clear and the receipt is signed. The paired potion’s original label reads: "A serum which can cause a wide range of plagues."

mastery_commentary.Pio: Neutralized yellow plague spores stay quarantined; the lace beneath the fungus is lovely, and the guild's seal stays closed.
mastery_commentary.Tia: Yellow Plague Serum is for controlled study, not healing. I color-matched the label from outside the jar and left it there.

2-24.description: The essence of the devil's pride.
2-24.bottle_note: Looking at the bottle for a long time can be dangerous.
2-24.original_bottle_note: Looking at the bottle for a long time can be dangerous.
2-24.expanded_lore: Lucifer’s golden tears crystallize beside a pride shrine and melt into Gold Essence of Pride’s almost molten finish. The old label calls it the devil’s essence; the glassmaker’s notes suggest the real trick was keeping the brilliant contents from looking like sunlight in a bottle.
2-24.supplier_note: The road office logged this Lucifer's golden tears parcel against Golden Essence of Pride. Keep it sealed until the workbench is clear and the receipt is signed. The paired potion’s original label reads: "The essence of the devil's pride."

mastery_commentary.Pio: Lucifer's golden tears make Gold Essence of Pride shine like molten light; the seal is gold-colored, not a coin to test it with.
mastery_commentary.Tia: The shrine's warm gleam is bottled in ordinary glass. I keep the ampoule upright, and Pio keeps his coins away from the seal.
